title: Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights
text: Any law that conflicts with the fundamental rights guaranteed in Part III of the Constitution is void to the extent of the inconsistency.

title: Equality before law
text: All citizens are equal before law and are entitled to equal protection of law.

title: Discrimination on grounds of religion, etc.
text: The State shall not discriminate against any citizen on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth. Women have equal rights with men in all spheres of State and public life.

title: Equality of opportunity in public employment
text: There shall be equality of opportunity for all citizens in respect of employment or office in the service of the Republic.

title: Right to protection of law
text: Every person is entitled to the protection of law and to be treated in accordance with law. No action detrimental to life, liberty, body, reputation or property may be taken except in accordance with law.

title: Protection of right to life and personal liberty
text: No person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty save in accordance with law.

title: Safeguards as to arrest and detention
text: An arrested person must be informed of the grounds of arrest as soon as may be, has the right to consult and be defended by a lawyer of choice, and must be produced before the nearest magistrate within twenty-four hours of arrest (excluding travel time). Preventive detention is subject to strict safeguards.

title: Prohibition of forced labour
text: All forms of forced labour are prohibited and any contravention is an offence punishable by law.

title: Protection in respect of trial and punishment
text: Protects against retrospective punishment and double punishment, guarantees a speedy and public trial by an independent and impartial court, prohibits compelled self-incrimination, and prohibits torture or cruel, inhuman or degrading punishment or treatment.

title: Freedom of movement
text: Every citizen has the right to move freely throughout Bangladesh, to reside and settle in any place, and to leave and re-enter the country, subject to reasonable restrictions.

title: Freedom of assembly
text: Every citizen has the right to assemble and participate in public meetings and processions peacefully and without arms, subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

title: Freedom of association
text: Every citizen has the right to form associations or unions, subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

title: Freedom of thought, conscience and speech
text: Freedom of thought and conscience, freedom of speech and expression, and freedom of the press are guaranteed, subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

title: Freedom of profession or occupation
text: Every citizen has the right to enter upon any lawful profession or occupation and to conduct any lawful trade or business, subject to qualifications prescribed by law.

title: Freedom of religion
text: Every citizen has the right to profess, practise or propagate any religion, and every religious community has the right to establish and maintain its religious institutions, subject to law, public order and morality.

title: Rights to property
text: Every citizen has the right to acquire, hold, transfer or otherwise dispose of property. No property shall be compulsorily acquired or requisitioned save by authority of law.

title: Protection of home and correspondence
text: Every citizen has the right to be secured in his home against entry, search and seizure, and to the privacy of his correspondence and other means of communication, subject to reasonable restrictions imposed by law.

title: Enforcement of fundamental rights
text: The right to move the High Court Division under Article 102 for the enforcement of the fundamental rights is guaranteed.

title: Culpable homicide
text: Causing death by an act done with the intention or knowledge that it is likely to cause death.

title: Murder
text: Defines when culpable homicide amounts to murder.

title: Punishment for murder
text: Sets the punishment for the offence of murder.

title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
text: Punishment for culpable homicide that does not amount to murder.

title: Causing death by negligence
text: Causing death by a rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide.

title: Attempt to murder
text: Doing an act with such intention or knowledge and in such circumstances that, if death were caused, it would be murder.

title: Hurt
text: Defines hurt as causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person.

title: Grievous hurt
text: Defines grievous hurt, such as loss of sight or hearing, fracture, dislocation, or hurt that endangers life.

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
text: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt other than grievous hurt.

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
text: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt.

title: Wrongful restraint
text: Voluntarily obstructing a person so as to prevent him from proceeding in a direction in which he has a right to proceed.

title: Wrongful confinement
text: Wrongfully restraining a person in such a manner as to prevent him from proceeding beyond certain limits.

title: Assault
text: Making a gesture or preparation intending or knowing it likely to cause another person to apprehend that criminal force is about to be used.

title: Assault on woman to outrage modesty
text: Assaulting or using criminal force on a woman intending to outrage or knowing it likely to outrage her modesty.

title: Punishment for kidnapping
text: Punishment for kidnapping from Bangladesh or from lawful guardianship.

title: Theft
text: Dishonestly taking movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent.

title: Punishment for theft
text: Sets the punishment for theft.

title: Extortion
text: Intentionally putting a person in fear of injury in order to dishonestly induce delivery of property or valuable security.

title: Robbery
text: Theft or extortion becomes robbery when accompanied by hurt, wrongful restraint or fear of instant death, hurt or restraint. Snatching property by force falls here.

title: Punishment for robbery
text: Sets the punishment for robbery.

title: Punishment for dacoity
text: Punishment for dacoity - robbery committed conjointly by five or more persons.

title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
text: Dishonestly misappropriating or converting to one's own use any movable property.

title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
text: Punishment where a person entrusted with property dishonestly misappropriates it or uses it in violation of the trust.

title: Cheating
text: Deceiving a person and fraudulently or dishonestly inducing him to deliver property or to do or omit something he would not otherwise do.

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
text: Punishment for cheating and thereby dishonestly inducing delivery of property or the making, altering or destroying of valuable security.

title: Criminal trespass
text: Entering on property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence or to intimidate, insult or annoy the person in possession.

title: Punishment for criminal trespass
text: Sets the punishment for criminal trespass.

title: Forgery
text: Making a false document or electronic record with intent to cause damage or injury, support a claim or title, or commit fraud.

title: Defamation
text: Making or publishing any imputation concerning a person intending to harm, or knowing it will harm, his reputation.

title: Punishment for defamation
text: Sets the punishment for defamation.

title: Criminal intimidation
text: Threatening a person with injury to his person, reputation or property with intent to cause alarm.

title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
text: Sets the punishment for criminal intimidation, with a higher punishment where the threat is to cause death or grievous hurt.

title: Word or gesture insulting the modesty of a woman
text: Uttering any word, making any sound or gesture, or exhibiting any object intending to insult the modesty of a woman or intruding upon her privacy.

title: Arrest without warrant
text: Describes when police may arrest a person without a magistrate's warrant.

title: Person arrested not to be detained more than twenty-four hours
text: A person arrested without warrant must not be detained longer than twenty-four hours without a magistrate's order, excluding travel time.

title: Information in cognizable cases (FIR)
text: Information about a cognizable offence given to the officer in charge of a police station must be recorded in writing and read over to the informant. This is the basis of the First Information Report (FIR).

title: Bail in non-bailable cases
text: Describes when a person accused of a non-bailable offence may be released on bail.

law: Nari o Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain 2000 (Women and Children Repression Prevention Act)
title: Punishment for rape and related offences
text: Provides the punishment for rape and for offences connected with rape under the special law for women and children.

law: Nari o Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain 2000 (Women and Children Repression Prevention Act)
title: Sexual oppression / sexual harassment
text: Provides punishment for sexual oppression, including touching a woman or child's body or sexual harassment with indecent intent.

law: Nari o Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain 2000 (Women and Children Repression Prevention Act)
title: Dowry-related death and hurt
text: Provides punishment for causing death or hurt, or attempting to do so, for dowry.

title: Domestic violence protection
text: Protects against physical, psychological, sexual and economic abuse within the family; allows protection orders, residence orders and compensation through the court.

title: Cyber offences
text: Covers cyber-related offences such as unauthorised access, publishing false or defamatory material online, identity fraud and sharing private images without consent. Load the official text for exact sections.

title: Wages, termination and workers' rights
text: Governs wages, working hours, leave, termination and compensation, safety and workers' rights. Load the official text for exact sections.

title: Transfer of property
text: Governs sale, mortgage, lease, exchange and gift of immovable property. Load the official text for exact sections.

title: Consumer rights
text: Protects consumers against adulteration, selling above the fixed price, fraudulent or defective goods and services. Complaints can be made to the Directorate of National Consumer Rights Protection.

title: Narcotics control
text: Governs possession, sale, production and use of narcotics. Load the official text for exact sections.

title: Road transport and traffic offences
text: Governs driving licences, traffic offences and penalties for negligent driving and accidents. Load the official text for exact sections.
